_about: Claude's review of each passing diff against the spec and the reference (#2095). verdict: correct | minor (works, deviates from the spec or style) | defect (a bug the test misses).

ship-turn.note: Same logic as the reference; a few redundant comments.

creature-chase.note: Territorial creatures lost the (p.seen || p.heard) condition: they now take hostile players they can neither see nor hear. The test uses sight=1000, so it can't notice.

trees-clearing.note: A tile counts as having a centre only when ready and centre.x != 0; the spec says any non-zero component. Equivalent in practice, not as specified.

fluid-cellkey.note: CellKey exact and all six cell-key call sites switched, as in the reference.

catalog-slots.note: Both assignments in the right functions; the test hook declared in gameui.h.

site-query.note: Same as the reference (without its comments).
